title: Hp500Loo
description: Catalog row hp500-loo 1.2.1: CrusherCal, the leave-one-survey-out validation of the calibrated backbone on the ten HP500 surveys, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/hp500/loo.py to data/derived/hp500/loo.json. Per target (throughput tph and power kW measured; P80 a model output reported as self-consistency), strict folds (every fitted scalar refit without the held-out survey) and leaky folds (fitted on all ten) grade M0 the calibrated backbone, M1 the backbone plus a bounded ridge residual, M2 a free-form least-squares fit, a constant-mean baseline and a label-shuffle negative control (from 1.2.0 also B_lin, the setting-only least-squares line on CSS, for both measured targets, and for power the two variants of Morrell's size-specific crusher energy, Morrell and Morrell_noload, whose M_ic and no-load power are fitted per fold because the ore's M_ic is not published); the strict folds carry an 80 percent predictive interval, its empirical coverage (in sample: sigma comes from the same residuals the coverage checks) and its nested coverage (out of sample: for each survey, sigma from the held-out residuals of the other surveys only). The two parity blocks are in-sample contrasts of the power forms and of the capacity backbone against the measured values. Deterministic for a seed. Derived from data licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://doi.org/10.3390/min14090919). Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: B_lin is present for tph and kW and Morrell, Morrell_noload and morrell_fit for kW in every strict and leaky block, and every pred list of them has n values; a held-out survey never enters its own fold (planted-target test); every measured and pred list has n values in survey order; the label-shuffle control does not beat M0 on throughput; nested_covered and nested_sigma have n values in survey order and nested_coverage is the share of true entries of nested_covered.

source.description: The source publication of the surveys (Rocha, Campos, Silva and Tavares 2024), as the survey reader states it.

engine_version.description: The product version that wrote the document (format X.XX.XXX); a version other than VERSION makes the row stale.

n.description: The number of surveys, and of folds of each block.

seed.description: The seed of the label-shuffle permutation (seed for throughput, seed + 1 for power, seed + 2 for P80).

resid_clip_frac.description: The bound of the bounded residual: at most this fraction of the backbone value at the held-out survey [fraction].

ridge_lambda.description: The ridge penalty on the two slopes of the bounded residual on the standardised features.

features.description: The features of the residual and free-form fits, in order: the closed-side setting and f80.

targets_primary.description: The measured targets: throughput (tph) and power (kW).

target_secondary.description: The model output reported as self-consistency only: P80.

k_s.description: K_s of the hardness parameter S_c (GMSG B5), 55 for a conventional crusher.

k2.description: K2 of equation B4, 1.0 closed circuit and 1.19 open circuit.

circuit.description: The circuit the K2 constant is taken for.

inputs.description: What the Morrell design column is computed from.

fitted.description: Which scalars are fitted per fold and why.

morrell.description: The constants and the fitted scalars of the two Morrell power variants.

config.description: The settings of the held-out evaluation.

tph.description: The evaluation on the measured throughput [t/h].

kW.description: The evaluation on the measured power [kW].

p80.description: The self-consistency check on the backbone's own P80, a model output and not a measurement [mm].

note.description: What the contrast shows, in words.

bond_pd_range_kw.description: The smallest and largest Bond draw of the engine over the surveys [kW].

measured_range_kw.description: The smallest and largest measured power over the surveys [kW].

bare_bond.description: The scores of the bare Bond draw against the measured power.

engine_pc_1p30_110.description: The scores of the paper's power form Pc = 1.30 Pd + 110 on the engine's Bond draw.

zeta.description: The fitted slope zeta of Pc = zeta Pd + Pn.

pn.description: The fitted no-load power Pn of Pc = zeta Pd + Pn [kW].

refit_pc.description: The scores of the same form refit by least squares on all ten surveys, with its two fitted scalars.

constant_mean.description: The scores of the mean measured power used as the prediction for every survey.

refit_pc.description: The form refit on all ten surveys [kW].

per_survey.description: The four powers of each survey, in survey order.

power_parity.description: In-sample contrast of the power forms against the ten measured powers.

note.description: What the contrast shows, in words.

backbone.description: The scores of the backbone throughput against the measured feed rate.

per_survey.description: The measured and the backbone throughput of each survey, in survey order.

tph_parity.description: In-sample contrast of the calibrated capacity backbone against the ten measured feed rates.

rmse.description: Root-mean-square error, in the target's unit [t/h, kW or mm].

r2.description: Coefficient of determination; 0 when the measured values have no variance.

maxdev_pct.description: The largest absolute percentage deviation over the surveys [%].

scores.description: The four scores of a set of held-out predictions against the measured values.

M0_backbone.description: Scores of the calibrated backbone, with its scalars refit per fold (QT for throughput, zeta and Pn for power).

M1_residual.description: Scores of the bounded residual: the backbone plus a ridge residual, clipped, on the standardised setting and f80.

M2_freeform.description: Scores of the free-form fit, an unconstrained least-squares plane on the setting and f80 predicting the target.

constant_mean.description: Scores of the control that predicts the mean of the fold's training surveys.

M1_label_shuffle.description: Scores of the control that fits the bounded residual to one seeded permutation of the measured values.

M0.description: Predictions of the calibrated backbone [t/h, kW or mm].

M1.description: Predictions of the bounded residual [t/h, kW or mm].

M2.description: Predictions of the free-form fit [t/h, kW or mm].

B_lin.description: Predictions of the setting-only least-squares line, throughput and power only [t/h or kW].

Morrell.description: Predictions of Morrell through the origin, power only [kW].

Morrell_noload.description: Predictions of Morrell with a no-load term, power only [kW].

pred.description: The held-out prediction of each model at each survey, in survey order, rounded to two decimals.

sigma.description: The sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of the ten held-out residuals of the calibrated backbone [t/h, kW or mm].

band_halfwidth.description: The half-width of the band, 1.2816 times sigma [t/h, kW or mm].

nominal_coverage.description: The coverage the band is built for, 0.80 [fraction].

empirical_coverage.description: The share of surveys whose held-out residual lies within the half-width, in sample [fraction].

band_rel_pct.description: The half-width in percent of the mean measured value [%].

note.description: How the band is built, in words.

nested_coverage.description: Out-of-sample coverage of the 80 percent band: the share of surveys whose held-out residual lies within the factor times the sigma of the other surveys' residuals [fraction].

nested_covered.description: Per survey, in survey order: whether its residual lay within the nested band.

nested_sigma.description: Per survey, in survey order: the sample standard deviation of the held-out residuals of the other surveys [t/h, kW or mm].

nested_note.description: States which coverage is in sample (empirical_coverage) and which is out of sample (nested_coverage).

uq.description: The 80 percent predictive band of the calibrated backbone from its strict held-out residuals, with its coverage.

B_lin.description: Scores of the setting-only least-squares line on the closed-side setting (throughput and power).

Morrell.description: Scores of Morrell's size-specific energy through the origin, M_ic refit per fold (power only).

Morrell_noload.description: Scores of Morrell's size-specific energy with a refit no-load power (power only).

morrell_fit.description: The scalars fitted in each fold (survey order, the held-out survey excluded from its own fold): M_ic of the through-origin variant [kWh/t], M_ic and the no-load power of the second variant, and whether that M_ic is positive (a negative M_ic is not Morrell's physics).

m_ic_kwh_t.description: M_ic of the through-origin variant in each fold [kWh/t].

m_ic_noload_kwh_t.description: M_ic of the variant with a no-load term in each fold [kWh/t].

no_load_kw.description: The no-load power of that variant in each fold [kW].

noload_variant_m_ic_positive.description: Whether that variant's M_ic is positive in each fold (a negative M_ic is not Morrell's physics).

folds.description: One set of folds (strict or leaky): the scores of every model and its held-out predictions.

target.description: The target: tph, kW or p80.

measured.description: The values the predictions are graded against, in survey order: measured for tph and kW, the backbone's own P80 for p80 [t/h, kW or mm].

strict.description: Strict folds: every fitted scalar refit without the held-out survey; they also carry the predictive band (uq).

leaky.description: Leaky folds: every model fitted on all ten surveys, so the gap to the strict folds measures the optimism of a leaking evaluation.

paper.description: Authors, year and title of the source publication.

doi.description: The DOI of the source publication.

license.description: The licence of the source data, which the derived document carries.

table.description: The table of the source publication the survey rows are transcribed from.
